description: This file implements hash storage and hashing functions for MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control) in etcd's storage layer, including hash computation, caching, and revision management.

classes.name: kvHasher
classes.description: A hasher for key-value pairs that computes a hash based on revisions and key-value data.

classes.name: KeyValueHash
classes.description: A struct representing the hash of a key-value pair along with revision metadata.

classes.name: hashStorage
classes.description: An implementation of HashStorage interface that caches hashes and manages hash history.

methods.name: unsafeHashByRev
methods.description: Computes hash of all key-value pairs up to a certain revision using an unsafe reader.

methods.name: newKVHasher
methods.description: Creates a new kvHasher instance with specified compact revision, revision, and keep map.

methods.name: WriteKeyValue
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the hash computation, considering revision and tombstone status.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Returns the overall hash, current revision, and error from the store.

methods.name: HashByRev
methods.description: Retrieves the hash for a specific revision, either from cache or by computing.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a new hash in the cache.

methods.name: Hashes
methods.description: Returns a list of recent stored hashes.
